name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
how_to:
Step 1: Setup and Starting Position
- Lie flat on a bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
- Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, arms extended directly above your chest.
- Keep your elbows locked in place and avoid excessive shoulder movement.
Step 2: Execution
1. Slowly lower the dumbbells toward your forehead by bending at the elbows.
2. Keep your upper arms stationary, allowing only your forearms to move.
3. Once the dumbbells are just above your forehead, pause briefly.
4. Extend your arms back to the starting position, fully straightening your elbows.
5. Repeat for 8 to 12 reps for 3 to 4 sets.
